summary: Obfuscated agent daemon bundling PTY/SSH with remote-driven self-replacement
details: @whalent/agent-core ships a 13.7MB webpack bundle at dist/index.cjs wrapped in obfuscator.io transforms (string-array rotator with 106,654 entries, hex-named identifiers, control-flow flattening). package.json declares main dist/index.cjs, bin whalent-core, and depends on ssh2 and node-pty. The README states the runtime is 'replaced by remote daemon upgrades', and bundle strings include process.env.SHELL and loopback references to 127.0.0.1:3389 (RDP) and 127.0.0.1:5900/5901 (VNC). The combination of an interactive PTY/SSH surface driven by a remote party plus a remote-controlled replacement channel for the package's own executable code gives the operator of that channel full interactive shell and code-execution access on any host running the daemon. The full-bundle obfuscation prevents identifying the specific remote endpoints, authentication scheme, or upgrade source.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
